report-cards.template.decision.heading: Decisions before editing
report-cards.template.decision.leadOne: The AI recommendation is already selected. Change only the cards you want, then review the summary on one
report-cards.template.decision.templateO: The cards below demonstrate the data attribute contract. In a real report, pair each card with
report-cards.template.decision.templateT: an id and answer in decisions.json, and replace the questions and options.
report-cards.template.decision.helper: Open through the helper to answer. You can also answer in chat.
report-cards.template.decision.questionF: Which option should be chosen first?
report-cards.template.decision.questionN: Which option should be chosen next?
report-cards.template.decision.reasonExa: Enter the recommendation and supporting evidence here.
report-cards.template.decision.compareEx: Enter compared options and tradeoffs here.
report-cards.template.direction.question: What creative direction and intensity should be used?
report-cards.template.direction.longDesc: Opening hook, selective highlights, measured density
report-cards.template.direction.shortDes: Frequent accents and bold text effects
report-cards.template.direction.calmDesc: Subtle sound effects and minimal ceremony
report-cards.template.direction.reasonEx: Explain the recommendation using the material and intended highlights.
report-cards.template.thumbnail.heading: 1. Thumbnail options
report-cards.template.thumbnail.leadOne: Review the choice that directly affects click-through rate first. Compare three
report-cards.template.thumbnail.template: The images below are safe template placeholders. In a real report, replace them with generated stills
embedded as data:image/*, and replace each provenance
report-cards.template.thumbnail.routeARe: Prioritizes a concrete source frame and reliable Japanese typography.
report-cards.template.thumbnail.routeBRe: Creates symbolic compositions unavailable in the footage.
report-cards.template.thumbnail.routeMix: Combines the flexibility of a generated background with accurate Japanese typography.
report-cards.template.analysis.heading: 2. Analysis summary
report-cards.template.analysis.lead: Track each asset summary and its supporting keyframes and transcript in this document.
report-cards.template.analysis.tableCapt: Analysis by asset and links to evidence
report-cards.template.analysis.qualityPl: Enter duration, video, and audio findings
report-cards.template.analysis.framePlac: Evidence keyframe placeholder; replace with the asset frame in a real report
report-cards.template.analysis.transcrip: Enter the supporting utterance as escaped text
report-cards.template.policy.heading: 3. Editing direction
report-cards.template.policy.lead: Show the recommended direction and reasons alongside the pros and cons of a viable alternative.
report-cards.template.policy.reasonPlace: Enter reasons based on analysis evidence
report-cards.template.policy.advantagePl: Enter conditions where the alternative is better
report-cards.template.policy.checkpointO: Review recommendation, alternative, and reasons; record explicit human approval in decision_log
report-cards.template.cuts.heading: 4. Cut decisions
report-cards.template.cuts.leadOne: Show keep/drop decisions in source time, with links to supporting events or
report-cards.template.cuts.singleOne: edit.json v0 supports one source only. Even when multiple assets are analyzed,
report-cards.template.cuts.singleTwo: do not silently merge sources; output only keep ranges for the approved single source
report-cards.template.assets.heading: 5. Asset plan
report-cards.template.assets.leadOne: Separate project-wide BGM from scene-specific SFX, B-roll,
report-cards.template.assets.leadTwo: captions, and special effects. Show the selection for each row: suggest if available / generate if unavailable
report-cards.template.assets.bgmPurpose: Enter tempo, mood, and volume direction
report-cards.template.assets.bgmDetail: Enter library candidates, license source, and preview information
report-cards.template.assets.brollPrompt: See generation prompt and still preview below
report-cards.template.assets.telopPatter: Enter an existing authoring pattern suggestion
report-cards.template.assets.specialUnus: Enter why the slot should stay empty
report-cards.template.assets.searchPlace: Enter search method and library name
report-cards.template.assets.brollImage: Generated B-roll still placeholder; approve this image before i2v
report-cards.template.assets.approvalOne: Embed the image in this report. Do not start i2v, avatar, or other costly video generation
report-cards.template.assets.approvalTwo: until the corresponding still has explicit approval.
report-cards.template.assets.checkpointO: Review choices, previews, prompts, and rejection reasons; record explicit human approval
report-cards.template.assets.checkpointT: in decision_log before confirming the execution plan.
report-cards.template.log.leadOne: Chronological record of direction, assets, methods, approvals, and rejections. Changes to the same
report-cards.template.log.leadTwo: (category, subject) are appended as new rows; earlier rows stay unchanged.
report-cards.template.log.ruleOne: Do not overwrite, delete, or reorder rows. For corrections, append a new sequence
report-cards.template.log.ruleTwo: for the same composite key, and explain its relationship to the previous decision.
report-cards.template.log.author: Recorder / provenance
report-cards.template.log.routeReason: Record the concrete source frame, flexibility of generated composition, and Japanese typography accuracy
report-cards.template.execution.leadOne: Review targets, methods, reasons, costs, load, and alternatives; record explicit human approval
report-cards.template.execution.leadTwo: in decision_log before generating edit.json v0 and final overlay
report-cards.template.footer.one: This self-contained HTML report does not load external CSS, JavaScript, or images.
report-cards.template.footer.two: Decision card answers are saved to the paired decisions.json through the localhost helper;
report-cards.template.footer.three: without the helper, the report is read-only.
report-cards.template.runtime.aiDefault: The AI recommendation is not unique; the first option is used as the default.
report-cards.template.runtime.unknownAns: An invalid answer with no matching card was excluded; other cards remain visible.
report-cards.template.runtime.invalidAns: This card has invalid answer data and is using its default.
report-cards.template.runtime.missingAns: This card has no answer data and is using its default.
report-cards.template.runtime.shapeMisma: This answer does not match the card declaration, so this card uses its default.
report-cards.template.runtime.undeclared: Answers without a declared card remain unchanged; only declared cards are shown.
report-cards.template.runtime.cannotConf: Cannot confirm because the answers could not be saved. Check the helper.
report-cards.template.runtime.alreadyCon: These answers have already been confirmed (409).
report-cards.template.runtime.confirmed: Confirmed. The agent will begin editing.
